messages:
maria-cs: HarborCare wants a short UK-focused demo Tue 09:30-10:30 UTC. They asked for a temporary QPS bump and a UK edge allowlist. renewal is sensitive so they want low latency. can eng ops help?
leo-sre: sure. hosted PAYG or dedicated? need org id, CIDRs, and peak qps. also confirm rollback plan.
maria-cs: Hosted. org id org-hc-309. CIDRs: 34.72.45.0/24, 34.72.46.0/24. peak qps requested 1,000 (baseline ~130). window 2026-06-15T09:30:00Z -> 2026-06-15T10:30:00Z. target p95 < 300ms.
sara-platform: we can prefer eu-west-2 and add proxy allowlist entries. recommend temp max_qps 1100 and breaker 1400. also suggest prewarming KV cache for clinician prompts.
leo-sre: plan: create temporary policy with soft cap 1100, circuit-break 1400, pin to London edge for the window. enabling enhanced logging for the org. snippet: {"org_id":"org-hc-309","start":"2026-06-15T09:30:00Z","end":"2026-06-15T10:30:00Z","max_qps":1100,"circuit_break_qps":1400,"allowlist":["34.72.45.0/24","34.72.46.0/24"]}
deploy-bot: ticket #CS-9817 created for temp policy + allowlist. assigned to leo-sre. auto-revoke scheduled.
ops-oncall: confirmed capacity in eu-west-2 for that hour; reserving burst pool. will monitor via #release-war-room and post status. enable token traces and latency alerts.
maria-cs: i'll send prewarm instructions and ask them to rotate keys. AE will join demo. thanks team :thumbsup:
leo-sre: policy pushed -> policy_id=tmp-hc-309-20260615. allowlist applied. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-hc-309/session-20260615
ops-oncall: standing by during window; will report any anomalies.
maria-cs: great — i will collect post-demo feedback and surface in renewal follow-up.
